hints.title: Long load
hints.fixAdvice: Aim for <10s: trim the top slices below.

hints.title: Hardcoded delays are on the critical path
hints.finding: 0.6s (3%) of this load is fixed UniTask.Delay-style gates.
hints.fixAdvice: These are free wins — replace fixed delays with event-driven readiness (SOAP events / NetworkVariable callbacks) or shrink the constants.

hints.title: A single frame froze for over a second
hints.fixAdvice: That work runs synchronously in one frame — spread it across frames (coroutine/UniTask batches) or pool/preload the assets.

hints.title: A large share of the load is unattributed
hints.fixAdvice: Add LoadInsights.Measure(...) spans around the code that runs there (check the stalls list and timeline gaps for where).
